language.reference_profile: Portable Python from the official Language Reference, with CPython-specific behavior isolated into named profile constructs.

constructs.title: Source encodings and encoding declarations
gaps: Need tokenizer-level model for UTF-8 default, coding comments, invalid encodings, and BOM behavior.

constructs.title: Physical lines, logical lines, comments, and line joining
gaps: The executable seed currently requires semicolon-separated simple statements and does not model Python newline handling.

constructs.title: Indentation, tabs, formfeeds, INDENT, and DEDENT
gaps: Need explicit block token model and diagnostics for inconsistent tab/space indentation.

constructs.title: Literal tokens

constructs.title: Generator, coroutine, and asynchronous generator objects

constructs.title: Code blocks, execution frames, and runtime context

semantics/python.k: internal #listCompIfs expression form evaluates multiple filter clauses left to right in the comprehension target environment before accumulating element-expression results

constructs.title: Primaries: attributes, subscriptions, slicing, and calls

slice object construction, start/stop/step attributes, equality, truthiness, and slice-object subscriptions over current string/list/tuple/range values; dict key lookup subset; internal #attr expression support for current range and slice start/stop/step attribute references; single-positional lambda calls; internal #call argument-list protocol for zero/multi-positional calls and starred positional call unpacking over current ordered concrete string/list/tuple/dict/set/range values, with sets using the current internal set iteration order profile; internal #callKw protocol for keyword-only calls without positional arguments over current function/lambda values, including default filling, mixed positional-plus-keyword-only callables with sparse keyword-only defaults, varargs callables with suffix defaults and keyword binding for fixed parameters, kwargs callables that collect unmatched keywords into a dict, positional-only callables that reject keyword binding for their positional-only prefix, and keyword argument unpacking over current concrete dict values with string keys; internal #callMixed protocol for mixed positional/keyword calls over current function/lambda values with starred positional unpacking and keyword argument unpacking over current concrete dict values with string keys; internal no-argument list/tuple/dict/set, one-argument list/tuple constructor expressions over current ordered concrete iterables, including set values through the current internal set iteration order profile, one-argument dict constructor expressions over current dict values plus concrete list/tuple pair iterables, keyword dict constructor expressions for simple keyword arguments and current concrete-dict keyword unpacking, and one-argument set constructor expressions over current concrete iterables; internal bool() and bool(x), all(x), any(x), sum(x), sum(x, start), one-iterable min(x)/max(x), and multi-argument min(a, b, ...)/max(a, b, ...) constructor/builtin expressions for current concrete truth-value, iterable, int-like sum, and int-like min/max subsets; constructs.title: Unary, binary, matrix, shift, bitwise, and arithmetic operations
